benign_lookalikes: legitimate startup shortcuts created by installers
Dropbox, OneDrive, Slack, Teams recreate their Startup .lnk after each update
Corporate login scripts writing a per-user Startup shortcut
A `.cmd` shim in Startup installed by a vendor driver package (e.g. printer suites)
An MSI whose CustomAction writes Startup directly - `filter_installer` only sees msiexec when it is the writing Image, not the parent of a helper
